item.title: How Vibe Coding Will Affect Traditional Dev Teams
item.description: Discover how vibe coding and AI-assisted development are reshaping traditional dev teams, workflows, and roles in the era of human–AI collaboration.

item.title: Outcome Based Context Engineering
item.description: Outcome Based Context Engineering is a shift from traditional prompt engineering toward designing AI interactions that start with the desired result and work backwards. Instead of micromanaging steps, this approach focuses on defining outcomes.

item.title: Why Dev AI Agents Need a Design System
item.description: We need a design system for Dev AI chat. A small, shared set of text-first components; cards, tables, alerts, diagrams, so no matter which agent you’re using, outputs look and feel the same.

item.title: Task Tool vs. Subagents: How Agents Work in Claude Code
item.description: As Claude Code continues to evolve, vibe coders are discovering powerful ways to orchestrate AI-driven workflows. Two key features that often cause confusion are the Task tool and the newer Subagent system.

item.title: Vibe Coding Best Practices to Get Better Results
item.description: A practical guide with actionable best practices to help you plan, run, and refine successful vibe coding sessions, combining AI speed with structure and good development habits.

item.title: We Need a 'Vibe Coder Advocate' to Support the Next Generation of Builders
item.description: Vibe coders are reshaping how software gets built and now its time we support them with a new kind of advocate.

item.title: What Slopsquatting Is and Why You Should Verify Your Dev AI Agent Installs
item.description: Learn what slopsquatting attacks are, how they target AI development tools and essential practices for verifying legitimate AI agent installations.

item.title: How Good at Coding do You Need to Be to Vibe Code?
item.description: When people hear about vibe coding, a common question that always comes up is ‘How good at coding do I need to be to do this?’ The answer, of course, is it depends.

item.title: An Overview of AI Guardrails
item.description: Learn what AI guardrails are, some terminology, the types of guardrails available and where they can be applied to in the AI lifecycle.

item.title: An Overview of AI Bias Types
item.description: Get an overview the various types of bias that can affect AI models, what they are and where they can manifest in the AI lifecycle.

item.title: A Business Overview of Retrieval Augmented Generation
item.description: Get a good overview of what Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) is and how your company can use it to generate accurate insights from your enterprise content.

item.title: Understanding Memory Systems in LLM Applications
item.description: Learn about six memory systems that can be implemented in your LLM-powered applications.
